inputs.name: value
inputs.description: The input value to be checked for changes and edge triggering

outputs.name: hasChanged
outputs.description: True indicates that the input value has changed

outputs.name: hasRisingEdges
outputs.description: True indicates that rising edges have occurred in the input value

outputs.name: risingBits
outputs.description: The bit stream of rising edges, where each bit indicates whether the corresponding input bit has experienced a rising edge (1 for a rising edge, 0 for no rising edge)

outputs.name: noOfRisingBits
outputs.description: The number of rising edges in the input value

outputs.name: hasFallingEdges
outputs.description: True indicates that falling edges have occurred in the input value

outputs.name: fallingBits
outputs.description: The bit stream of falling edges, where each bit indicates whether the corresponding input bit has experienced a falling edge (1 for a falling edge, 0 for no falling edge)

outputs.name: noOfFallingBits
outputs.description: The number of falling edges in the input value
